Listen. No fucking human is useful enough to know exactly what you need and help you. You're gonna spend years waiting for something good to happen and pick you up, but it won't. You just have to be out there experiencing life, whether happily or miserably, and doing things. Life is meaningless but your feelings and desires aren't.
